message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"extractFile","explanation":"In extractFile, entryName is derived from ZipEntry.getName() and passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName). The only guard is `if ( !f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith( dir.getAbsolutePath() ) )`, which is an inadequate containment check because it does not append a path separator or normalize the absolute paths; an entry name like ../out_evil can produce an absolute path such as /destination/../out_evil that still starts with /destination but resolves outside the target directory. The resulting File f is then used in new FileOutputStream(f), so attacker-controlled archive entry names can reach the FileOutputStream sink and write outside the intended directory."}]}
